The panel clearly shows a specific clinical manifestation of the configured target disease.

panels.rationale: Electron micrograph of a human renal biopsy glomerular capillary loop from a patient with biopsy-confirmed argyria; the image shows scattered electron-dense silver granules in the mesangium and glomerular basement membrane, a direct histopathological manifestation of systemic silver deposition (argyria). Real patient pathology image, not a diagram, chart, control or animal model; arrows annotate the silver granules. Renal silver deposition is a recognized but less common site of argyria, hence variant typicality.
